[name="Raidian"]目测是二十四人战术编队，后面可能还有援军。阿米娅，我们必须加快速度了。
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_1037_amiya3_1#6$1",focus="l")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_4179_monstr_1#6$1",focus="l")]
[name="阿米娅"]（低声）博士，快上来！
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_4179_monstr_1#6$1",focus="r")]
[name="Mon3tr"]博士，快，把手给我！
[Dialog]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_4179_monstr_1#6$1",focus="none")]
[Decision(options="我在努力——", values="1")]
[Predicate(references="1")]
[charslot]
[PlaySound(key="$rungeneral",volume=1)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4225_tanya_1#1$2",afrom=0,ato=1,duration=1)]
[charslot(slot="m",posfrom="100,0",posto="0,0",duration=1.5)]
[Delay(time=1.5)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4225_tanya_1#1$2",focus="none")]
[name="严肃的卫兵"]——攻击前面那个家伙，她想偷溜进去！
[Dialog]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_arrow_rain",volume=1)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0.5, r=1, g=1, b=1, fadetime=0.05, block=true)]
[PlaySound(key="$rungeneral",channel="2",volume=1)]
[CameraShake(duration=2, xstrength=50, ystrength=50, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[charslot(slot="m",afrom=1,ato=0,duration=1)]
[charslot(slot="m",posfrom="0,0",posto="-100,0",duration=1.5)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=3, block=true)]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_1037_amiya3_1#6$1",focus="none")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_4179_monstr_1#6$1",focus="none")]
[Decision(options="拉我一把！", values="1")]
[Predicate(references="1")]
[charslot]
[CameraShake(duration=1, xstrength=40, ystrength=40, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0.5, r=1, g=1, b=1, fadetime=0.05, block=true)]
[PlaySound(key="$explolarge1")]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_erthshkng", volume=1, loop=true, channel="e")]
[CameraShake(duration=3, xstrength=30, ystrength=30, vibrato=90, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=3, block=true)]
[StopSound(channel="e", fadetime=3)]
混乱的声响当中，有一瞬间你的呼喊似乎被淹没了。
在自己这双手能从昏暗中抓住任何东西之前，一个有点熟悉的、穿着防护服的身影快速朝你冲来。
[dialog]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4225_tanya_1#1$2",afrom=0,ato=1,duration=0.5)]
[charslot(slot="m",posfrom="-50,0",posto="0,0",duration=0.5)]
[Delay(time=1)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4225_tanya_1#1$2",focus="m")]
[name="瑭雅"]站稳了。
[Dialog]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_clothmovement",volume=1)]
[CameraShake(duration=1.5, xstrength=10, ystrength=10, vibrato=90, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[Delay(time=1.5)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4225_tanya_1#1$2",focus="none")]
这身影冲向你，而后顺势将你用力托举，直到你终于抓住Mon3tr的手，站上牵引车的边缘。
在你来得及反应之前，那双帮过你的手的重量就消失不见了。
[Dialog]
[Decision(options="你是……？;谢谢你——", values="1;2")]
[Predicate(references="1;2")]
[PlaySound(key="$bodyfalldown1",volume=1)]
[charslot(slot="m",afrom=1,ato=0,duration=0.5)]
[charslot(slot="m",posfrom="0,0",posto="100,-20",duration=0.5)]
[CameraShake(duration=1, xstrength=10, ystrength=10, vibrato=90, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[Delay(time=1)]
[charslot]
你回头看去，那个穿着防护服的身影动作有些笨拙地想要攀上牵引车，最终也没有成功，跌落在地上。
